scope: Retrospective descriptive interval inclusion from canonical three-way cross-fit authorities on already-opened dependent CIFAR-10-C cells; no fitting or new data access.

calibration.method: cell-outcome-disjoint fit/calibrate/score cross-fit with exact-rank residual calibration
calibration.pool: per-fold residual-calibration subset disjoint from both estimator-fit and score cells; unchanged across family summaries
calibration.reuse_warning: The opened dependent grid is reused for retrospective cross-fit diagnostics; this is not independent calibration validation.

units.record: candidate x run seed x controlled condition
units.repetitions: 5 run/stream seeds conditional on the archived checkpoint, not 5 independent checkpoints
units.groups: 3 candidates; 6 corruption families each; 2160 cells/candidate; 360 cells/family/candidate
units.weighting: each saved cell has equal weight; no aggregation across candidate policies
units.outcome: measured cell accuracy benefit B = adapted accuracy - frozen accuracy; not population benefit
units.interval_inclusion: abs(current cross-fit prediction - B) <= radius, including equality and all +infinity intervals
units.interval_width: 2 * epsilon (full, unclipped width), accuracy proportion units, not percentage points
units.commitment: (ADAPT + FREEZE) / all cells; different from interval inclusion and adapt rate
units.false_adapt: ADAPT and B <= 0; marginal denominator all cells; conditional denominator ADAPT cells
units.false_freeze: FREEZE and B >= 0; marginal denominator all cells; conditional denominator FREEZE cells
units.undefined_values: null plus defined=false/reason for zero-denominator rates; positive_infinity status for unbounded width
units.scientific_authority_comparisons: exact Python numeric/object equality; no tolerance or rounded-table comparisons

does_not_establish: exchangeability or independence of the related grid cells
selection-conditional coverage or conditional false-commitment control
coverage of population risk or a new confirmatory experiment
